description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'EmployeeLeaveSearchFilterParams' used for encapsulating search filter parameters in the Employee Leave module of OrangeHRM. It extends 'LeaveSearchFilterParams' and includes properties for date range, leave statuses, employee number, and inclusion criteria, along with associated getters and setters. It also utilizes traits for leave request service integration.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class that encapsulates filtering parameters for Employee Leave searches, including date ranges, statuses, employee number, and inclusion options.

methods.name: getStatuses
methods.description: Returns the array of leave statuses for filtering, mapped to internal status identifiers.

methods.name: setStatuses
methods.description: Sets the leave statuses for filtering, validating against known statuses and converting to internal identifiers.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date of the filter range.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the filter range.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Retrieves the end date of the filter range.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the filter range.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number to filter by.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number to filter by.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the inclusion criteria string for employee filtering.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the inclusion criteria string for employee filtering.
